adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#2
adds.text: Coulson meets Talbot face to face and offers him Creel in exchange for leaving S.H.I.E.L.D. alone. When Talbot tries to arrest him, the cloaked Bus appears with its guns trained on the general.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: S.H.I.E.L.D. leader who hands Talbot Creel and warns him off the hunt.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: General who tries to arrest Coulson and is faced down by the Bus.
adds.evidence: Heavy Is the Head (S2E2): Coulson offers Talbot a deal, turns Creel over and tells him he is wasting his time; Talbot tries to capture him until the Bus decloaks with guns aimed.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#3
adds.text: Fitz goes down to Ward's cell, and when Ward tries to explain himself, Fitz starts draining the oxygen from the cell. He lets slip that the team is after Donnie Gill, and Ward warns him Gill is a Hydra asset.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Former friend who nearly suffocates Ward in his cell.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Hydra traitor Fitz confronts in his cell and nearly suffocates.
adds.evidence: Making Friends and Influencing People (S2E3): Fitz enters Ward's cell, drains its oxygen, reveals Gill is the target; Ward warns Gill was a Hydra asset.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#9
adds.text: Ward boards the Bus to take Raina, and May leads the agents surrounding him at gunpoint. She lets Skye go with him only so the Hydra jets outside hold their fire.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Bitter enemy who holds Ward at gunpoint aboard the Bus.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Bitter enemy who boards the Bus and takes Skye from May.
adds.evidence: ...Ye Who Enter Here (S2E9): May leads the agents, guns drawn, surrounding Ward as he enters the Bus; Ward promises the quinjets won't fire if Raina and Skye come; Skye convinces May to let her go.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#18
adds.text: Coulson captures Ward and makes a deal with him: Ward helps him get inside Hydra in exchange for a clean slate.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Old leader who strikes a deal with Ward against Hydra.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Hydra traitor Coulson uses to get inside Hydra.
adds.evidence: The Frenemy of My Enemy (S2E18): Coulson, Hunter, Fitz and Peterson capture Ward and Palamas and make a deal to infiltrate Hydra in exchange for giving Ward a clean slate.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#3
adds.text: May knows Jemma is undercover in Hydra, so when Hunter lines up a shot on her she shoots Hunter to stop him, and lets Jemma escape with Donnie Gill to keep her cover.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A close friend who guards Jemma's cover inside Hydra.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend May protects while she is undercover in Hydra.
adds.evidence: Making Friends and Influencing People (S2E3): Hunter lines up a shot on someone he doesn't know is Simmons; May wounds Hunter to stop him; May, who knows of Simmons' mission, allows her and Gill to escape to maintain her cover.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#19
adds.text: On the raid on Hydra's Arctic base, May guards Fitz while he hacks the base's defense system.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The agent who guards Fitz while he hacks Hydra's defenses.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The engineer May guards while he hacks Hydra's defenses.
adds.evidence: The Dirty Half Dozen (S2E19): May, Coulson and Fitz take down the defense system; May defended Fitz while he hacked Hydra's system.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#19
adds.text: Hill calls Coulson, and he gives her the Hydra intel he found on Strucker's base and tells her to assemble the Avengers.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An old colleague who passes Hill the intel on Strucker's base.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An old colleague Coulson sends the intel on Strucker's base.
adds.evidence: The Dirty Half Dozen (S2E19): Coulson is called by Maria Hill and gives her the intel from the Hydra base, telling her to assemble the Avengers; Wikipedia: he gives the location to Hill so the Avengers can defeat Hydra.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#12
adds.text: When Sif comes after Skye, May takes Skye to Vault D and tries to calm her. Skye knocks herself out with May's I.C.E.R., which convinces Sif to leave her to May's team.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An Asgardian warrior who comes after Skye while May shields her.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow warrior who shields Skye from Sif in Vault D.
adds.evidence: Who You Really Are (S2E12): Sif and Vin-Tak go after Skye; May takes Skye to Vault D; Sif's arrival agitates Skye, who shoots herself with May's I.C.E.R., convincing Sif Skye can be handled by her team. May and Coulson then escort Sif away.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#12
adds.text: Coulson's team helps an amnesiac Sif catch the Kree Vin-Tak, and Coulson talks her out of taking Skye. Sif warns him that Skye may be more dangerous than he knows.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An Asgardian warrior Coulson talks out of taking Skye.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The agent who helps Sif catch Vin-Tak and keeps Skye from her.
adds.evidence: Who You Really Are (S2E12): S.H.I.E.L.D. helps amnesiac Sif, captures Vin-Tak; Coulson convinces Sif to leave Skye be; Sif warns Coulson Skye may be a greater danger than he realizes.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#1
adds.text: In 1945, Peggy leads an SSR raid on Hydra's last base with the Howling Commandos beside her.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Peggy's old war unit. They raid Hydra's last base with her.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The SSR agent who leads the Commandos in a 1945 raid on Hydra.
adds.evidence: Shadows (S2E1): in Austria, 1945, Peggy Carter leads a raiding party of SSR troops, with Dum Dum Dugan and Jim Morita, into Reinhardt's Hydra facility.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#1
adds.text: Dugan rides with the Commandos on Peggy's 1945 raid on Hydra's last base.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: One of the Commandos on Peggy's 1945 raid on Hydra.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Dugan's unit, raiding Hydra's last base with him in 1945.
adds.evidence: Shadows (S2E1): Dum Dum Dugan is part of Peggy Carter's 1945 raid on the Hydra facility; the episode credits the Howling Commandos in flashback.

adds.evidence: Shadows (S2E1): Jim Morita is part of Peggy Carter's 1945 raid on the Hydra facility; the episode credits the Howling Commandos in flashback.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#1
adds.text: Dugan and Morita raid Hydra's last base together under Peggy in 1945.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Howling Commando on Peggy's 1945 raid.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Howling Commando on Peggy's 1945 raid.
